description:
Use this when the user wants the last change to a clip or photo taken back: "undo that", "I liked it better
before". Restores the version saved before the last edit; calling again steps further back (the last 20 saves
are kept for 7 days).
Not for: deleting a clip (done in RipClip). Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id; job_status waits for it.

clip_id.description: Clip or photo id from list_clips.

name: undo_edit
title: Undo the last edit
